name: Privacy-friendly embeds
description: Turns standalone YouTube, Vimeo and TikTok links into click-to-load video players. Nothing is requested from the video site until the visitor presses play; then the player loads from youtube-nocookie.com, Vimeo with Do Not Track, or TikTok's embed player. Without JavaScript the link stays a plain link.
author: sap13ns

purpose.en: Plays the YouTube videos linked in posts, from youtube-nocookie.com. Nothing loads until you press play; then YouTube receives your IP address and may store data on your device.
purpose.es: Reproduce los vídeos de YouTube enlazados en las entradas, desde youtube-nocookie.com. No se carga nada hasta que pulsas reproducir; entonces YouTube recibe tu dirección IP y puede guardar datos en tu dispositivo.

purpose.en: Plays the Vimeo videos linked in posts in Do Not Track mode. Nothing loads until you press play; then Vimeo receives your IP address and may store technical data on your device.
purpose.es: Reproduce los vídeos de Vimeo enlazados en las entradas en modo «Do Not Track». No se carga nada hasta que pulsas reproducir; entonces Vimeo recibe tu dirección IP y puede guardar datos técnicos en tu dispositivo.

purpose.en: Plays the TikTok videos linked in posts. Nothing loads until you press play; then TikTok receives your IP address and may set cookies as on tiktok.com.
purpose.es: Reproduce los vídeos de TikTok enlazados en las entradas. No se carga nada hasta que pulsas reproducir; entonces TikTok recibe tu dirección IP y puede crear cookies como en tiktok.com.

settings.label: YouTube links
settings.help: Embed youtube.com and youtu.be links with the privacy-enhanced player (youtube-nocookie.com).

settings.label: Vimeo links
settings.help: Embed vimeo.com links with Vimeo's player in Do Not Track mode (dnt=1).

settings.label: TikTok links
settings.help: Embed tiktok.com video links with TikTok's embed player. TikTok has no privacy-enhanced mode: nothing loads from TikTok until the visitor presses play, but then TikTok may set cookies like on tiktok.com.

settings.label: Privacy note
settings.help: Shown under every embed. {provider} becomes YouTube, Vimeo or TikTok. Empty uses a built-in note in the post's language (English or Spanish).

settings.label: Privacy note in Spanish
settings.help: Used for Spanish posts instead of the note above.

settings.label: Privacy note in English
settings.help: Used for English posts instead of the note above.

settings.label: Privacy policy link
settings.help: https://…, http://… or a site path such as /privacy. Adds a "Privacy policy" link after the note. Empty adds no link.
